parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight metal, typically aluminum or stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and fit.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight metal, typically aluminum or stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and ensures symmetrical balance with the left leg.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, typically made of durable plastic or composite material.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the main structure for vision correction or protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support to which the legs are hinged.
